title: Category
description: One entry of data/categories.yaml: a group of datatypes that answers one question about a value.

id.description: Unique among all category ids and aliases.

kind.description: topic: the subject area of the value. form: the general form of a value that has no subject. sensitivity: the value needs protection. standard: the standard that defines the value.

description.description: What belongs in the category, and what belongs elsewhere. Required when a record uses the category.

aliases.description: Former category ids that this category replaces. They keep resolving.
